annotations.title: Questions the connected person has not answered yet

description: For a connected person: the common application questions they have not answered yet, and the facts missing for each job in their work history. Ask them all in one message BEFORE opening an employer's form, so the form never stops half-way. Leave include_role_specific off when asking the person what to fill in. Set it only while filling one employer's form: it returns, in a separate list, questions only some jobs ask (polygraph, CDL, security clearance, sales numbers) - ask the person only the ones that form actually asks.

access_token.description: Not needed when the person signed in through your Connect / sign-in button (OAuth). Otherwise the access_token from finish_connecting.

include_role_specific.description: Only while filling a specific form; default off
